inputs.text: A clean commercial product photograph of a single structured caramel-brown leather handbag standing on a light ivory travertine plinth. The bag has a gently curved top handle, a front flap, one brushed gold rectangular turn-lock clasp, subtle cream stitching along its edges, and fine natural leather grain. No shoulder strap, no brand marks, no lettering. Three-quarter front view that clearly shows the front, side gusset, handle and clasp, with the entire bag inside the square frame. Soft warm gray seamless studio background, diffused light from the upper left, delicate realistic shadow beneath the bag. Refined understated accessories catalog photography, crisp material details, no extra objects, no watermark.
